decision: Project Mag_2 as static HPMaxUp +0.1 through the existing modify-pack domain (dedicated build test file: frozen Suit10/Mag_2 binding, native 0 below threshold / 1/10 at two pieces, Studio 1000->1100 at two pieces, additive 1350 vs multiplicative 1375 oracle, equipped threshold-2 contribution 1/10 with Mag_2 evidence, native reader Hpsuit_4_HpMaxUp=1/25 and Hpsuit_4_CD=10, rejection cases). Model the 4pc as independent +4% Max HP stacks on positive settled HP loss (cap 10, 10s each, discard at cap without refresh) and ten stacks on admitted Ultimate cast, applied before same-time hits. Effective Max HP is base times one plus summed bonus, rounded once to nearest integer; current HP is unchanged on grant and clamped to the effective max on expiry (clamp covered by a Be-Happy-heal scenario test).
hypothesis_rationale: The description grants Max HP per HP-loss instance and ten stacks on Ultimate cast, each stack lasting ten seconds. Model one stack per positive settled loss and a full ten-stack grant on admitted Ultimate, before same-time hits (CausalPriority orders the cast grant at BuffTickOrExpiry ahead of HitDelivery; trace-enforced by test). At the stated cap, discard further grants without refreshing, consistent with the independent-stack model; a dedicated falsifier test distinguishes discard from refresh (t=9s hit at cap, all stacks gone at t=10.000001s). The ten-stack cap has no native curve and is taken from the description text. Per-stack 4% and 10s durations are frozen single-coordinate curves (Hpsuit_4_HpMaxUp=1/25, Hpsuit_4_CD=10). Current HP unchanged on grant and clamped on expiry is enforced by the generic max-HP expiry machinery and covered by a heal-then-expire scenario test. Source tables establish constants and the buff dependency but not grant timing, cap replacement or HP settlement rounding; these remain tested hypotheses.
independent_oracles: Zero/one piece: zero HP bonus; two/three/four pieces: 1/10 static HPMaxUp via Mag_2 with native evidence.
Native stat projection: one piece -> HPMaxUp 0; two pieces -> 1/10 via Mag_2 (empty ConditionArray).
Studio 0..=4 pieces with base HP override 1000: 1000 below threshold, 1100 at two pieces; HPMaxUp not in unmodeled_attributes; Mag_2 table evidence present exactly at/above threshold.
1000 base + manual hp_percent 1/4 + two-piece: 1000 x 27/20 = 1350, not 1000 x 1.25 x 1.1 = 1375; one piece gives 1250; native HPMaxUp 1/5 + 1/10 = 3/10.
1000 base HP: one damage stack gives effective Max HP 1040; ten stacks give 1400. Current HP is unchanged by grants.
Twelve damage events at 0.5s spacing: ten stacks held, two discarded at cap; effective Max HP 1400; twelve grant trace events, the last two still reporting 10/10.
Stacks at t=0 and t=5s with 10s duration: at t=10.000001s one stack remains, effective Max HP 1040.
Ultimate at t=0 (ten stacks) plus damage at t=9s at cap: at t=10.000001s zero stacks remain, effective Max HP 1000; a refresh-at-cap model would give 1400.
Zero delivered damage grants no stack and emits no grant trace event; effective Max HP stays 1000.
Admitted Ultimate cast: ten stacks, effective Max HP 1400, before same-time hits.
Damage and Ultimate at the same timestamp t=0: the Ultimate grant is trace-visible at 10/10 before the damage grant, which is discarded at cap; effective Max HP 1400, current HP 900.
Off-field wearer damage still grants; ally without the set is unaffected.
Be Happy heal to 1100 HP under ten stacks, then expiry at t=10s: current HP clamped 1100 -> 1000 with a max_hp_stack_expired trace event reporting 1400->1000.
limits: Grant timing, discard-at-cap behavior, Ultimate stack replacement, Ultimate-before-hits ordering and HP settlement rounding are modeled hypotheses with dedicated falsifier/order tests, not verified native rules.
The ten-stack cap is description-derived; no native stack-count curve exists for this set.
The clamp-on-expiry test reaches current HP above the post-expiry max via the character-specific Be Happy heal (no generic heal event exists); the clamp itself is generic max-HP expiry machinery.
Studio set_count declares geometry applicability; native equipped builds retain actual console packing validation. Full acquisition/release availability remains unverified.
Runtime Max HP buffs are new shared machinery; only Suit10 uses the max_hp_bonus modifier key so far.
